_comment: Edit the expIDs before running the workflow. This example is now set up for movie-only basal/apical summaries.

_field_help.user_id: Lab user folder name used to resolve /home/<user_id>/data/Repository.
_field_help.repo_base: Repository base path. Keep the standard lab root unless your data live elsewhere.
_field_help.remote_repo_base: Raw remote repository path used for trial CSVs and rapid-ret fallback when processed soma data is missing.
_field_help.basal_expids: Movie expIDs that should be pooled as basal dendrite sessions.
_field_help.apical_expids: Movie expIDs that should be pooled as apical dendrite sessions.
_field_help.soma_expids: Optional rapid-retinotopy expIDs. Leave empty for movie-only runs.
_field_help.soma_group_map: Optional explicit pairing map for soma-enabled runs. Not needed for movie-only basal/apical summaries.
_field_help.channel: Suite2p channel index used for the cut bundles.
_field_help.output_dir: Directory where the manifest and figures will be written.
